label: Large Slanted Flap 6.0 cm
description: The large slanted flap is the same hacking-style pocket cut at a steeper angle or with a noticeably wider and deeper flap, creating a more emphatic visual statement on the hip. It is associated with tweed country jackets, overcoats, and double-breasted suits where a commanding lower pocket anchors the jacket's weight and presence. The scale suits taller clients or those wearing voluminous cloth — flannel, tweed, or heavy barathea — where a standard-width flap would look pinched or understated.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
